newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Pick rallies on Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Pick rallies on Budapest bourse.

text.p: Hungary's meat processor company Pick reached a 52-month high on Wednesday of 8,500 forints, up 395, but traders could not pinpoint a reason for the rise.
"There are some bits of encouraging news about Pick, but it would be hard to single out one factor," said Peter Haas of Postabank Securities.
But Haas said one important element was that Pick would probably have a better 1997 contract with its distributor in Germany, its main export market.
He added that Pick remained flat for most of the year while leading shares of the Budapest Stock Exchange put on more than 100 percent in 1996.
"Pick has been very cheap so far," Haas added.
